firmware.title: Firmware updates
firmware.description:
Updates run in topology order: outermost devices first, then the devices they hang off, the gateway last and always alone. A device and its uplink never update at the same time. At most the configured number of APs and switches run in parallel. Per room at least one switch always stays online to recover the others after a failure (with 3 switches at most 2 at once). The room is the device's Home Assistant area. Without an area it is taken from the device name, default: part before the first “-” (B1-SW-01 → B1). After the first error no further updates start.

Devices on the “manual only” list are skipped by bulk updates and only updated when installed individually or named explicitly.

data.firmware_max_switch_site: Max. switches at once per room

user.title: Add person (presence)
user.description: Presence from this person's devices. Arrival is immediate; leaving is confirmed only after the grace period – short if the last connection ended at an exit access point (e.g. entrance), long otherwise (phone sleeping inside the house). Additional sources (e.g. Companion app, BLE) keep the person home as long as they report home/on. Tip: add the created device trackers to the HA person.
